name: Counter Dashboard — Submit counted task to supervisor
description: Counter logs in with test_counter and submits the counted task TS-ITEM-001 to the supervisor cartable.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the login page at /login
Enter test_counter into the username field and Test@123456 into the password field
Click on the item row with code TS-ITEM-001 to open its detail view
Click the submit button labelled ثبت و ارسال به سرپرست
Verify that a success toast or notification appears indicating the item has been submitted to the supervisor
